full_judgment: 2. The short fact is that the respondents as plaintiffs instituted Title Suit No.139 of 1973 in the Second Court of Munsif, Khulna for declaration of title, recovery of possession of the suit land after demolishing the structures thereon and for mesne profit and permanent injunction alleging, inter alia, that the suit land recorded in C.S. Khatian No.361 of Mouja Uttardihi, under police station Fultali belonged to Sabed Gazi and Altab Gani in equal shares under the superior landlord Nironjan Roy Chowdhury. Sabed Gazi and Aftab Gazi on receipt of salami orally settled .60 acres of land of plot No.931 and .22 acres of land of plot No.555 in Baishakh, 1333 B.S. with one Achora Khatun alias Achia Khatun and handed over possession to her. The said .22 acres of land of Plot No.555 in the land in dispute in the suit, .61 acres of land of another C.S. Khatian being C.S. Khatian No.362 was under possession of one Easaruddin Karikar who settled the same with Erfan Karikar. Erfan Karikar settled the said land along with other lands by a patta dated 21.3.1929 to the said Achiya Khatun and thus Achiya Khatun ,acquired right, title and possession over the land of the patta. The land of C.S. Khatian No.361 was sold in auction in rent. Execution case for arrears of rent due to the superior land lord and the same was purchased by one Wahab Ali Mir, who transferred the same to Baru Bibi and Amena Khatun by Kabala. Osman Khan, the appointed court guardian of Baru Bibi and Amena Bibi filed rent suit No.1 of 1946 in the Third Court of Munsif against Achhiya Khatun which was disposed of on compromise. The superior landlord Niranjan Roy Chowdhury sold the jams in auction in Execution Case No.89 of 1950 of the third Court of Munsif. Achhiya Khatun deposited decrectal money and the sale was set aside on contest. Thereafter, Baru Bibi and Amena filed Rent Suit No.1478 of 1955 in the Third Court of Munsif against Achhiya Khatun, Abdul I Mazid. The husband of Bata Bibi got an ex-parte decree. Achiya Khatun filed Title Suit No. 268 of 1958 in the same court for setting aside the said ex-parte decree which was decreed on contest in favour of her. Achhiya Khatun while in khas possession transferred the suit land along with other lands by a kabala dated 9.6.1953 to the plaintiffs and delivered possession thereof. The suit land was wrongly recorded in the name of defendant Nos.5-11 in S.A. Khatian. Defendant Nos.1-4 are close relations of the plaintiffs husband and they have/had no right title in the suit land. The defendant Nos. 1-4 forcibly entered into the suit land on First Push, 13.78 B.S. and have been living there since then by erecting houses and hence the suit.
